patches.name: Remove ads and promotions
patches.description: Experimental: hides shared launcher/status-window ads, news, featured servers, carousel, marketing links, radio upsells and promotional inbox rows. Centers the Home launch card and Friends panel in a bounded two-column layout. Clears layout alerts including service announcements. Disables one Electron integrity fuse; this invalidates the executable signature and removes embedded ASAR validation. Both packs tested on copies; launchpad and Mission Control checked live on 3.7.24-ow. Full UI coverage remains unverified.

patches.name: Local cosmetics
patches.description: Experimental: local outfit/badge mutations, inspected outgoing cosmetic push suppressed, and built-in cloth cloak physics available through Locker. Select Local Outfit, Equip a cloak, and enable Cloth Cloak beneath the character preview. Cloth settings save locally; Render Cloth Cloaks must be enabled in Lunar cosmetic settings. Requires account/default outfit/catalog assets. Unequip online cosmetics BEFORE applying; saved online outfits can remain visible to others. Login/assets use the network; emotes/sprays are outside scope and favorites are not persisted. Restore before game updates. Multiplayer privacy remains unverified.

patches.name: Disable automatic updates
patches.description: Stops automatic launcher update checks at startup, on timers and after channel changes. Blocks server-requested launcher updates, including force-install requests, and disables installation on app exit. Manual Check for updates remains available; restore patches before updating Lunar. Requires Remove ads and promotions for its launcher archive compatibility change. Game/runtime downloads during Minecraft launch are separate and remain unchanged.

patches.name: Faster bootstrap download fallback
patches.description: Optional: limits connection establishment to 15 seconds and tries each existing Maven repository once. After a repository connection times out, skips that origin for subsequent Maven artifacts in the same JVM, avoiding repeated 15-second waits on cold-cache launches such as 26.3. A fresh launch retries all origins. Keeps the 180-second request deadline, reachable repository order, cached archive checks and download validation. Single-URL retry behavior remains unchanged. Supports only the exact tested Genesis fingerprint. Restore before updating Lunar. Cannot recover a dependency unavailable from every remaining repository.

patches.name: Remove in-game promotions
patches.description: Experimental: hides main-menu Store/Discover buttons, news carousel, coin purchase control, Medal quests/rewards, promotional video and Discord reward cards, countdown, Wrapped card and partner radio widget. Removes the Locker shop/Purchase Lunar+ link and preview checkout/back-to-store controls. Keeps Singleplayer, Multiplayer, Locker/local outfits, theme selector, ordinary alerts and preview exit controls. Requires the exact inspected extracted UI bundle b6d39b2; changing UI builds or re-extracting the cache can remove the cleanup. No launcher/game/bootstrap verification bypass is added. Automated checks passed; live game testing is requested from the user.
